description: This file contains unit test code for the quic::test namespace, specifically testing the QuicUdpBatchWriter functionality, including socket creation, address support, and packet read/write validation.

classes.name: QuicUdpBatchWriterIOTestDelegate
classes.description: Abstract base class for delegate used in UDP batch writer tests, providing interface for skipping tests, resetting writers, and obtaining writer instances.

classes.name: QuicUdpBatchWriterIOTestParams
classes.description: Struct holding parameters for UDP batch writer I/O tests, including delegate, address family, data size, and packet size.

classes.name: QuicUdpBatchWriterIOTest
classes.description: Parameterized test fixture class for testing QuicUdpBatchWriter's basic packet IO capabilities, including socket setup, write/read validation, and skipping unsupported configurations.

methods.name: IsAddressFamilySupported
methods.description: Checks if the given address family (AF_INET or AF_INET6) is supported on the system by attempting to create a socket.

methods.name: CreateSocket
methods.description: Creates and binds a UDP socket for the specified address family, setting the provided QuicSocketAddress and file descriptor.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the test parameters as a formatted string for logging.

methods.name: MakeQuicBatchWriterTestParams
methods.description: Generates a vector of test parameter sets for different address families, data sizes, and packet sizes.

methods.name: QuicUdpBatchWriterIOTest
methods.description: Test fixture class that initializes sockets, performs write/read validation, and manages test execution for UDP batch writer.

methods.name: ShouldSkip
methods.description: Determines if the current test configuration should be skipped based on system support.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up sockets and addresses for testing, and resets the writer delegate.

methods.name: GetWriter
methods.description: Returns the current QuicUdpBatchWriter instance from the delegate.

methods.name: ValidateWrite
methods.description: Performs a write test by sending packets of specified size until total data size is reached, then flushes and verifies total bytes sent.

methods.name: ValidateRead
methods.description: Performs a read test by receiving packets and verifying their contents and source addresses.
